sec02-card-sec02-R05.question_text: When does Minnesota's road-test retest fee start, and what is the exact dollar charge per attempt?
sec02-card-sec02-R05.teaching_text: Road retests cost double the ten-dollar written retest fee once you pass two failures.

sec02-card-sec02-R18.question_text: Once an applicant under eighteen passes the road test, which four adults are authorized to sign the license application?
sec02-card-sec02-R18.teaching_text: County-appointed foster parents and transitional-living directors hold explicit signing authority alongside parents and guardians.

sec03-card-sec03-F01.question_text: Which four categories of adults may approve a permit or license application for someone under eighteen?
sec03-card-sec03-F01.teaching_text: Notice guardians must be court-appointed and foster parents county-appointed, alongside parents and transitional-living directors.

sec03-card-sec03-F02.question_text: When a teen's parents are divorced, who holds legal authority to approve the driving application?
sec03-card-sec03-F02.teaching_text: A non-custodial parent cannot sign in place of the custodial parent or that parent's married stepparent.

sec03-card-sec03-F03.question_text: Who may sign for a teen who is married, emancipated, or has no living parent or guardian, and how old must they be?
sec03-card-sec03-F03.teaching_text: Even when a spouse, employer, or close relative signs, that signer still has to be eighteen or older.

sec03-card-sec03-F04.question_text: Once an adult approves a teen's driving application, is that signature permanent or reversible?
sec03-card-sec03-F04.teaching_text: Whoever signed your application retains the power to pull that approval back if unsafe habits show up.

sec03-card-sec03-F05.question_text: When can a host sponsor sign for a foreign exchange student, and what two notarized forms are needed otherwise?
sec03-card-sec03-F05.teaching_text: Without court guardianship papers, natural parents must notarize separate forms covering both the permit and provisional stages.

sec03-card-sec03-F06.question_text: Under Graduated Driver's Licensing, how long must a learner eighteen or younger hold an instruction permit before road testing?
sec03-card-sec03-F06.teaching_text: Graduated licensing locks in half a year of supervised seasons before solo driving begins.

sec03-card-sec03-F07.question_text: How long is an instruction permit valid, where does your licensed supervisor sit, and must you carry the card?
sec03-card-sec03-F07.teaching_text: Practicing with your permit left on the kitchen counter or without a front-seat licensed driver is illegal.

sec03-card-sec03-F08.question_text: At age fifteen, which two driver-ed classroom paths qualify for a permit, and when does driver ed stop being required?
sec03-card-sec03-F08.teaching_text: Teens choose either full thirty-hour completion or fifteen concurrent hours, while adults eighteen-plus skip classroom driver ed.

sec03-card-sec03-F09.question_text: Beyond age and classroom hours, which five counter steps complete getting your instruction permit?
sec03-card-sec03-F09.teaching_text: Every permit applicant clears ID verification, eyesight screening, the knowledge test, application paperwork, and fee payment.

sec03-card-sec03-F10.question_text: For a permit holder under eighteen, what supervisor age, occupant belt rule, and cell-phone rule apply?
sec03-card-sec03-F10.teaching_text: Hands-free Bluetooth calls are banned right alongside handheld phones while practicing on a teen permit.

sec03-card-sec03-F11.question_text: When the permit holder is eighteen or older, how old must the supervising driver be and who wears restraints?
sec03-card-sec03-F11.teaching_text: Adult learners drop the supervisor age floor from twenty-one down to eighteen while keeping every seat belted.

sec03-card-sec03-F12.question_text: How many months of practice driving precede the road test generally versus at age nineteen or older?
sec03-card-sec03-F12.teaching_text: Reaching age nineteen cuts the mandatory permit practice stretch in half from six months to three.

sec03-card-sec03-F13.question_text: How do you replace a lost or expired instruction permit, and how long does the replacement run?
sec03-card-sec03-F13.teaching_text: Instead of ordering a short-term duplicate, applying for a fresh permit resets a full two-year window.

sec03-card-sec03-R01.question_text: Combine a teen permit holder's supervisor minimum age, cell-phone ban, and two classroom-hour paths?
sec03-card-sec03-R01.teaching_text: Keeping twenty-one for supervision separate from thirty or fifteen classroom hours prevents number mix-ups.

sec03-card-sec03-R02.question_text: How do supervisor age at eighteen-plus and road-test wait time at nineteen-plus ease up for adult permit holders?
sec03-card-sec03-R02.teaching_text: Watch those two birthdays carefully because supervisor age shifts at eighteen while the three-month wait starts at nineteen.

sec03-card-sec03-F14.question_text: Which GDL stage is the provisional license, how long is it valid, and what belt and phone rules carry over?
sec03-card-sec03-F14.teaching_text: Graduating from a permit lets you drive solo, yet hands-free phone calls stay banned and every seat stays belted.

sec03-card-sec03-F15.question_text: What minimum age, driver-education milestones, and clean permit stretch are required for a provisional license?
sec03-card-sec03-F15.teaching_text: Any moving, alcohol, or controlled-substance conviction during your six permit months delays provisional eligibility.
sec03-card-sec03-F15.must_match_memory_hook: Sixteen, both ed phases, six clean

visual_sync.text_span: Sixteen, both ed phases, six clean

sec03-card-sec03-F16.question_text: How does a parent completing the optional parent class change the total and nighttime hours on your supervised log?
sec03-card-sec03-F16.teaching_text: Notice the fifteen nighttime hours stay identical either way; the parent class trims ten daytime hours off fifty.
sec03-card-sec03-F16.must_match_memory_hook: Forty with parent class, fifty without

visual_sync.text_span: Forty with parent class, fifty without

sec03-card-sec03-F17.question_text: Along with age, education, and logged hours, what exam and approval complete provisional licensing?
sec03-card-sec03-F17.teaching_text: Passing on the course still needs an approved adult's signature on your provisional application.

sec03-card-sec03-F18.question_text: During the first six provisional months, which overnight hours are restricted and which exceptions allow driving?
sec03-card-sec03-F18.teaching_text: Notice a licensed passenger lifts the midnight-to-five curfew only at age twenty-five or older, alongside work or unbused school events.

sec03-card-sec03-F19.question_text: During the first six months on a provisional license, how many passengers under twenty may ride without a parent or guardian?
sec03-card-sec03-F19.teaching_text: Capping young peers at one cuts cabin noise and distraction during your first solo half year.

sec03-card-sec03-F20.question_text: During the second six months on a provisional license, how many passengers under twenty are allowed without a parent or guardian?
sec03-card-sec03-F20.teaching_text: Months seven through twelve expand your under-twenty peer limit from one up to three.

sec03-card-sec03-F21.question_text: How do immediate family members under age twenty affect the provisional passenger caps?
sec03-card-sec03-F21.teaching_text: Driving younger siblings to school never eats into your one- or three-peer limit in either six-month half.

sec03-card-sec03-R03.question_text: How long do both the instruction permit and the provisional license last, and from what date does each run?
sec03-card-sec03-R03.teaching_text: Each two-year clock starts ticking on its respective application date rather than your birthday.
sec03-card-sec03-R03.must_match_memory_hook: Both run two years from application

visual_sync.text_span: Both run two years from application

sec03-card-sec03-R04.question_text: What overnight hours trigger the provisional curfew, and what minimum age lets a licensed companion lift it?
sec03-card-sec03-R04.teaching_text: Do not confuse age twenty-one for permit supervision with age twenty-five for lifting the provisional curfew.

sec03-card-sec03-R05.question_text: Compare the under-twenty passenger limits across months one-to-six and seven-to-twelve, and who lifts both?
sec03-card-sec03-R05.teaching_text: Notice Minnesota sets the passenger age line at under twenty rather than twenty-one.
sec03-card-sec03-R05.must_match_memory_hook: One first, three second, parents lift

visual_sync.text_span: One first, three second, parents lift

sec03-card-sec03-F22.question_text: Why was Vanessa's Law enacted, and which two teen violation categories trigger it?
sec03-card-sec03-F22.teaching_text: Named after Vanessa Weiss, the law targets teens involved in impaired offenses or crash-related moving violations.

sec03-card-sec03-F23.question_text: Until what age is an unlicensed teen barred from any permit or license after a crash-related or alcohol-or-drug conviction?
sec03-card-sec03-F23.teaching_text: DWI, Implied Consent, Open Bottle, Not a Drop, or crash moving convictions lock an unlicensed teen out until eighteen.
sec03-card-sec03-F23.must_match_memory_hook: Zero permit or license until eighteen

visual_sync.text_span: Zero permit or license until eighteen

sec03-card-sec03-F24.question_text: Once that unlicensed teen turns eighteen under Vanessa's Law, what four steps stand before taking a road test?
sec03-card-sec03-F24.teaching_text: Turning eighteen only opens the door; you still reinstate, pass written, and hold a permit six or three months.

sec03-card-sec03-F25.question_text: When can a provisional driver revoked under Vanessa's Law regain a license?
sec03-card-sec03-F25.teaching_text: If your withdrawal period stretches past your eighteenth birthday, you wait until the longer date finishes.
sec03-card-sec03-F25.must_match_memory_hook: Eighteen or withdrawal end, whichever later

visual_sync.text_span: Eighteen or withdrawal end, whichever later

sec03-card-sec03-F26.question_text: Which five hurdles—including the exact fee and classroom rule—apply when reinstating that revoked provisional holder?
sec03-card-sec03-F26.teaching_text: Online shortcuts are barred here; reinstatement demands thirty in-person classroom hours plus a six hundred eighty dollar fee.

sec03-card-sec03-F27.question_text: After reinstating into a permit under Vanessa's Law, how long do you hold it and what training happens inside?
sec03-card-sec03-F27.teaching_text: Completing six behind-the-wheel hours across that ninety-day permit stretch precedes applying for your license.
sec03-card-sec03-F27.must_match_memory_hook: Hold ninety days, six instructor hours

visual_sync.text_span: Hold ninety days, six instructor hours

sec03-card-sec03-R06.question_text: Contrast the Vanessa's Law waiting period for an unlicensed teen against a revoked provisional holder?
sec03-card-sec03-R06.teaching_text: A revoked provisional holder faces whichever date lands later between birthday eighteen and the withdrawal end.

sec03-card-sec03-F28.question_text: Which two eligibility routes qualify a driver for an Under-Twenty-One Class D license?
sec03-card-sec03-F28.teaching_text: A seventeen-year-old upgrades early by logging twelve straight provisional months free of substance or crash-moving convictions.
sec03-card-sec03-F28.must_match_memory_hook: Turn eighteen or twelve clean months

visual_sync.text_span: Turn eighteen or twelve clean months

sec03-card-sec03-F29.question_text: At most how many non-crash moving-violation convictions may an Under-Twenty-One Class D applicant have?
sec03-card-sec03-F29.teaching_text: A second non-crash moving ticket blocks upgrading before eighteen even when nobody crashed.

sec03-card-sec03-F30.question_text: If upgrading to the Under-Twenty-One license before turning eighteen, what extra supervised hours must you certify?
sec03-card-sec03-F30.teaching_text: Provisional teens upgrading early still log at least ten additional hours alongside a twenty-one-plus licensed adult.

sec03-card-sec03-F31.question_text: How much fee credit do you earn when upgrading from a provisional license with a spotless record?
sec03-card-sec03-F31.teaching_text: Staying completely violation-free on your provisional license knocks three dollars and fifty cents off your upgrade.

sec03-card-sec03-F32.question_text: How is a pre-twenty-one license labeled, when does it expire first, and how often does it renew afterward?
sec03-card-sec03-F32.teaching_text: Watch your wallet on your twenty-first birthday because that Under-Twenty-One card expires right on that day.

sec03-card-sec03-F33.question_text: Which three specialized licenses or permits can a fifteen-year-old earn after driver ed and a road test?
sec03-card-sec03-F33.teaching_text: Outside standard permits, age fifteen opens only narrow agricultural, household-medical, or moped credentials.

sec03-card-sec03-F34.question_text: When and how far may a fifteen-year-old drive solo on a restricted farm license, and when can the restriction come off?
sec03-card-sec03-F34.teaching_text: Night trips and social errands stay banned until you hold the farm card six months and reach sixteen.
sec03-card-sec03-F34.must_match_memory_hook: Daylight farm work within forty miles

visual_sync.text_span: Daylight farm work within forty miles

sec03-card-sec03-F35.question_text: What waiting rule do farm-work and special-medical applicants bypass, and which three items must they still complete?
sec03-card-sec03-F35.teaching_text: Urgent farm or medical needs waive the six-month calendar hold, not the permit, behind-the-wheel certificate, or log.

sec03-card-sec03-F36.question_text: What two household and medical facts justify a special medical license at fifteen, and what restriction code prints on it?
sec03-card-sec03-F36.teaching_text: If even one licensed driver already lives at home, a fifteen-year-old will not qualify for MEDLIM.

sec03-card-sec03-F37.question_text: Contrast the course and testing requirements for a moped permit at fifteen against riding an electric-assist bicycle?
sec03-card-sec03-F37.teaching_text: Mopeds demand a safety course plus written, vision, and road tests, while e-bikes require only age fifteen.

sec03-card-sec03-R07.question_text: Which three weight, passenger-capacity, or cargo traits push a single-unit vehicle outside a standard Class D license?
sec03-card-sec03-R07.teaching_text: Note the exact weight trigger starts at twenty-six thousand one pounds, alongside sixteen-person buses and hazmat loads.

sec03-card-sec03-R08.question_text: Within what distance and by which three drivers may a farm truck haul farm goods on a Class D license?
sec03-card-sec03-R08.teaching_text: For-hire commercial haulers cannot use this exemption; it covers only the farmer, immediate family, or farm workers.

sec03-card-sec03-R09.question_text: Which emergency, recreational, and small-vehicle types are covered by a Class D license, and which one needs an endorsement?
sec03-card-sec03-R09.teaching_text: Three-wheeled autocycles and personal motor homes run on Class D, whereas two-wheeled motorcycles still need endorsement.

sec03-card-sec03-R10.question_text: When must you carry your license, what prints on its back, and how many license classes exist in Minnesota?
sec03-card-sec03-R10.teaching_text: Flipping a Minnesota card over reveals your exact class, endorsements, and restrictions across the state's four-class system.

sec03-card-sec03-R11.question_text: What trailer weight may a Class D driver always tow, and when is towing a heavier trailer allowed?
sec03-card-sec03-R11.teaching_text: A trailer above ten thousand pounds stays Class D legal only while truck plus trailer stay at twenty-six thousand or under.

sec03-card-sec03-R12.question_text: Which six vehicle or cargo types require endorsements, and which three of them require an extra road test beyond written?
sec03-card-sec03-R12.teaching_text: Doubles, tankers, and hazmat add written exams, while motorcycles, buses, and school buses also test behind the wheel.
sec03-card-sec03-R12.must_match_memory_hook: Six endorsed; bus, school, motorcycle road-test

visual_sync.text_span: Six endorsed; bus, school, motorcycle road-test

sec03-card-sec03-R13.question_text: What vehicles do commercial Classes A, B, and C include alongside their class rigs, and what happens under twenty-one?
sec03-card-sec03-R13.teaching_text: Holding a commercial A, B, or C card automatically covers everyday Class D cars, with age limits before twenty-one.
sec03-card-sec03-R13.must_match_memory_hook: Include Class D, restricted under twenty-one

visual_sync.text_span: Include Class D, restricted under twenty-one

sec03-card-sec03-R14.question_text: Which three workplace vehicle types can trigger commercial motor carrier rules and federal medical certificates?
sec03-card-sec03-R14.teaching_text: Even without needing a CDL, driving company vans over ten thousand pounds, package trucks, or nine-person shuttles triggers carrier rules.

sec03-card-sec03-R15.question_text: Once you are twenty-one, when and how often does a Minnesota license renew, what check applies, and how are lost cards replaced?
sec03-card-sec03-R15.teaching_text: Every four-year birthday renewal screens your eyesight again, while lost or damaged plastic gets replaced with a duplicate.

sec03-card-sec03-R16.question_text: Within how many days must you get a duplicate after a name or address change, and how differs replacing a lost permit?
sec03-card-sec03-R16.teaching_text: Licenses take a thirty-day duplicate for updates, whereas losing an instruction permit means renewing the permit itself.

sec03-card-sec03-R17.question_text: When must an active-duty military member renew a Minnesota license, with what papers, and which family members qualify?
sec03-card-sec03-R17.teaching_text: Bringing your license and DD-214 within a year of discharge covers service members, plus out-of-state spouses and dependents under twenty-six.

sec03-card-sec03-R18.question_text: Which vehicle taxes and DVS fees are waived for a veteran rated one hundred percent total and service-connected disabled?
sec03-card-sec03-R18.teaching_text: Minnesota waives title, license, and ID fees plus sales, registration, and wheelage taxes on up to two vehicles.

sec03-card-sec03-R19.question_text: What service length and discharge types qualify for the optional veteran license indicator, and does it alter VA benefits?
sec03-card-sec03-R19.teaching_text: Adding the Veteran mark is optional recognition after active service and changes zero federal VA benefit eligibility.

sec03-card-sec03-R20.question_text: How does license renewal timing work for Peace Corps volunteers and federal foreign service employees holding valid Minnesota licenses?
sec03-card-sec03-R20.teaching_text: Just like military separations, returning volunteers and foreign service staff get one full year after service ends.

sec03-card-sec03-R21.question_text: How does applying for a Minnesota license or ID handle Selective Service for ages eighteen-to-twenty-six and under eighteen?
sec03-card-sec03-R21.teaching_text: Submitting an application under eighteen queues your registration automatically until your eighteenth birthday arrives.

sec03-card-sec03-R22.question_text: Can you hold a Minnesota state ID card alongside a valid license or permit, and what statement changes that?
sec03-card-sec03-R22.teaching_text: Getting a state ID requires signing a downgrade statement that surrenders your driving privileges.

sec03-card-sec03-R23.question_text: What does twenty-dollar fast track service speed up, and for which three card transactions is it unavailable?
sec03-card-sec03-R23.teaching_text: Paying twenty extra gets three-day processing and ten-day UPS adult-signature delivery, except on first licenses, upgrades, or enhanced cards.
sec03-card-sec03-R23.must_match_memory_hook: Three-day processing, barred first, enhanced, upgrades

visual_sync.text_span: Three-day processing, barred first, enhanced, upgrades

sec09-card-sec09-F01.question_text: Which set of standards do Minnesota's road signs, traffic lights, and pavement lines follow?
sec09-card-sec09-F01.teaching_text: Matching national design rules ensures drivers crossing state borders recognize stops, lanes, and warnings instantly.

sec09-card-sec09-F02.question_text: Why are road sign shapes and background colors standardized into distinct categories?
sec09-card-sec09-F02.teaching_text: Spotting an octagon or yellow diamond early gives you reaction time in rain or glare long before small letters sharpen.

sec09-card-sec09-R01.question_text: Which seven common road sign shapes does the Minnesota driver's manual identify?
sec09-card-sec09-R01.teaching_text: Recognizing all seven distinct outlines lets you read stops, yields, school zones, and rails even when snow covers the face.

sec09-card-sec09-R02.question_text: What two visual elements do road signs combine to communicate instructions clearly?
sec09-card-sec09-R02.teaching_text: Pairing standard icons with short text lets drivers grasp turn bans or hazards in a split-second glance.

sec09-card-sec09-F03.question_text: On regulatory signs, what distinct roles do red and white play?
sec09-card-sec09-F03.teaching_text: Red demands immediate halts or bans dangerous moves, whereas white posts everyday lane, turn, and speed rules.

sec09-card-sec09-F04.question_text: How do yellow, yellow-green, and orange divide up warning duties along the road?
sec09-card-sec09-F04.teaching_text: Separating standard yellow hazards from bright crossing zones and orange roadwork tells you immediately who is ahead.
sec09-card-sec09-F04.must_match_memory_hook: Yellow general, green-yellow crossings, orange work

visual_sync.text_span: Yellow general, green-yellow crossings, orange work

sec09-card-sec09-F05.question_text: What type of traveler information does each color carry on green, blue, and brown signs?
sec09-card-sec09-F05.teaching_text: Scanning by background color lets you spot highway exits, gas or hospital stops, and state parks without hunting every word.
sec09-card-sec09-F05.must_match_memory_hook: Green guides, blue services, brown parks

visual_sync.text_span: Green guides, blue services, brown parks

sec09-card-sec09-R03.question_text: Which exact zones reserve yellow-green warning signs versus orange warning signs?
sec09-card-sec09-R03.teaching_text: Confusing fluorescent school or bike crossing signs with orange construction zones mixes up kids on foot and heavy machinery.

sec09-card-sec09-F24.question_text: While most warning signs use standard yellow, which three crossing or zone signs may appear in fluorescent yellow-green?
sec09-card-sec09-F24.teaching_text: High-visibility fluorescent yellow-green pops out at dawn and dusk wherever walkers, cyclists, and students cross.

sec09-card-sec09-F06.question_text: What legal duty do regulatory signs carry, and what happens if you disobey one?
sec09-card-sec09-F06.teaching_text: Regulatory panels are enforceable traffic laws rather than polite tips, so blowing past one brings a ticket and fine.

sec09-card-sec09-F07.question_text: What complete sequence must you follow at a Stop sign before proceeding?
sec09-card-sec09-F07.teaching_text: Rolling stops skip the visual scan needed to let pedestrians and priority cross traffic clear the intersection completely.

sec09-card-sec09-F08.question_text: How must you adjust your driving and priority when approaching a Yield sign?
sec09-card-sec09-F08.teaching_text: A Yield sign demands a full stop whenever cross traffic or walkers occupy your gap, never a forced merge.

sec09-card-sec09-F09.question_text: What does a Do Not Enter sign facing your windshield forbid you from doing?
sec09-card-sec09-F09.teaching_text: Exit ramps and one-way throats post Do Not Enter panels at the entrance to block head-on entries before they start.

sec09-card-sec09-F10.question_text: What urgent mistake has already happened if you spot a Wrong Way sign ahead?
sec09-card-sec09-F10.teaching_text: Seeing Wrong Way means you slipped past the entrance and are now aimed nose-to-nose against opposing traffic.

sec09-card-sec09-R04.question_text: How does the meaning of a Do Not Enter sign differ from a Wrong Way sign?
sec09-card-sec09-R04.teaching_text: Do Not Enter stops you at the threshold, while Wrong Way warns you have already crossed into opposing lanes.

sec09-card-sec09-F11.question_text: What universal message does a red circle with a diagonal red slash over a black symbol send?
sec09-card-sec09-F11.teaching_text: Whether covering a left arrow, U-turn arrow, or letter P, the red slash bans the depicted action immediately.

sec09-card-sec09-F12.question_text: What do speed limit signs and interstate minimum speed signs require, and when may you drop below a minimum?
sec09-card-sec09-F12.teaching_text: Crawling below an interstate minimum on dry pavement causes rear-end wrecks, though ice or fog requires slowing down.

sec09-card-sec09-F13.question_text: What roadway boundary does a white regulatory Do Not Pass sign mark?
sec09-card-sec09-F13.teaching_text: Hills, curves, or intersections just ahead hide oncoming cars, making overtaking past the white sign illegal.

sec09-card-sec09-R06.question_text: Which side of a two-way highway carries the No Passing Zone warning sign, and what does it mark?
sec09-card-sec09-R06.teaching_text: Mounting the yellow pennant on the left shoulder keeps it visible even when a tall semi trailer blocks right-side signs.

sec09-card-sec09-F14.question_text: What traffic rule does a black-and-white One Way sign enforce?
sec09-card-sec09-F14.teaching_text: Turning against a One Way arrow puts you head-on into every lane on the street.

sec09-card-sec09-F15.question_text: Where does a Keep Right regulatory sign direct you to steer?
sec09-card-sec09-F15.teaching_text: Steering left of a raised divider nose drops you straight into opposing turn lanes.

sec09-card-sec09-F16.question_text: How should you use lane-choice signs posted ahead of a multilane roundabout?
sec09-card-sec09-F16.teaching_text: Swapping lanes inside the circular roadway causes sideswipes, so line up left or right turns before entering.

sec09-card-sec09-R05.question_text: In the manual's multilane roundabout sign example, which lanes may continue straight through?
sec09-card-sec09-R05.teaching_text: While left and right turns lock to outer or inner lanes, both lanes often share straight-through arrows.

sec09-card-sec09-F17.question_text: What does a lane-use control sign require when you are in its marked lane?
sec09-card-sec09-F17.teaching_text: Driving straight out of an arrow-marked turn-only lane cuts directly across adjacent cars that also share options.

sec09-card-sec09-F18.question_text: What must you do at an intersection posted with a No Turn on Red sign?
sec09-card-sec09-F18.teaching_text: Blind sightlines or heavy crosswalk foot traffic make red-light turns unsafe where No Turn on Red appears.

sec09-card-sec09-F19.question_text: Who may use a center lane marked with a left-turn-only sign, and for what single maneuver?
sec09-card-sec09-F19.teaching_text: Using a shared center turn lane as a passing or cruising lane risks a head-on wreck with opposing turners.

sec09-card-sec09-F20.question_text: What action should you start taking as soon as you spot a Reduced Speed Ahead sign?
sec09-card-sec09-F20.teaching_text: Coasting down early lets you hit the upcoming town or school speed limit cleanly instead of braking late past the sign.

sec09-card-sec09-F21.question_text: What does a white diamond symbol painted or posted on a lane indicate?
sec09-card-sec09-F21.teaching_text: Solo passenger cars entering a carpool, bus, commercial, or bicycle diamond lane face restricted-lane citations.

sec09-card-sec09-F22.question_text: Which vehicles are legally allowed to park in spaces marked by blue disability parking signs?
sec09-card-sec09-F22.teaching_text: Even quick two-minute stops without valid disability plates or a hung permit block essential access ramps.

sec09-card-sec09-F23.question_text: How may a driver with valid disability plates or a permit park if every designated disability space is full?
sec09-card-sec09-F23.teaching_text: Angling across two regular stalls guarantees extra door-swing and wheelchair-lift clearance when accessible stalls are taken.

sec09-card-sec09-F25.question_text: Which three white pavement markings appear on the road surface ahead of a railroad crossing?
sec09-card-sec09-F25.teaching_text: Spotting the painted X, letters RR, and stop bar on the asphalt warns you early even when trees hide trackside posts.

sec09-card-sec09-F26.question_text: What does a white X-shaped crossbuck sign mark, and what extra sign appears when multiple tracks cross?
sec09-card-sec09-F26.teaching_text: A track-count plaque under the crossbuck warns you to watch for a second hidden train on parallel rails.

sec09-card-sec09-F27.question_text: How does an Exempt sign at a railroad crossing change the rule for bus and truck drivers?
sec09-card-sec09-F27.teaching_text: Inactive spurs post Exempt plaques to prevent pointless rear-end stops, though drivers must still scan both ways.

sec09-card-sec09-F28.question_text: What three actions should you take when you pass a circular Railroad Crossing Ahead sign?
sec09-card-sec09-F28.teaching_text: Because freight trains need over a mile to stop, only your early slowdown and scan can prevent a crossing crash.

sec09-card-sec09-F29.question_text: What shape and colors identify a school zone sign, and what does it warn is ahead?
sec09-card-sec09-F29.teaching_text: Five-sided yellow or fluorescent yellow-green signs mean unpredictable young walkers are close ahead.

sec09-card-sec09-F30.question_text: How must you drive when reaching a posted school crossing sign?
sec09-card-sec09-F30.teaching_text: Students step into school crosswalks expecting immediate right-of-way, so stay poised over the brake pedal.

sec09-card-sec09-F31.question_text: What three responses does a pedestrian crossing warning sign call for?
sec09-card-sec09-F31.teaching_text: Pedestrian crossing diamonds mark busy foot corridors where walkers may step off curbs at any moment.

sec09-card-sec09-R07.question_text: What companion sign sits directly underneath standard school crossing and pedestrian crossing signs?
sec09-card-sec09-R07.teaching_text: An advance sign warns ahead, whereas a downward arrow plaque pinpoints the exact painted crosswalk lines.

sec09-card-sec09-F32.question_text: Which vehicles must display the slow-moving vehicle emblem, and how should you react when spotting one?
sec09-card-sec09-F32.teaching_text: Closing at highway pace on a tractor or buggy under thirty miles per hour leaves seconds unless you brake early.

sec09-card-sec09-F33.question_text: How should you overtake animal-drawn vehicles, and what nighttime lighting must they carry?
sec09-card-sec09-F33.teaching_text: Fast passes spook horses toward traffic, and a five-hundred-foot lamp helps drivers spot buggies after sunset.

sec09-card-sec09-F34.question_text: What does a yellow T-intersection ahead sign tell you about your lane and priority?
sec09-card-sec09-F34.teaching_text: Missing a T-sign in fog or darkness sends cars straight off the far shoulder across live cross traffic.

sec09-card-sec09-R08.question_text: What upcoming road feature and action does a yellow crossroad sign warn about?
sec09-card-sec09-R08.teaching_text: Rural crossroad signs flag hidden side streets behind cornfields or snowbanks where cross traffic can appear fast.

sec09-card-sec09-R09.question_text: What specific traffic movement does a side road warning sign alert you to watch for?
sec09-card-sec09-R09.teaching_text: Drivers pulling out from hidden side roads may accelerate slowly into your lane right around a hill or bend.

sec09-card-sec09-R10.question_text: What two things should you prepare for when approaching a Y-intersection warning sign?
sec09-card-sec09-R10.teaching_text: Forking roads require picking left or right early while scanning for oncoming traffic slicing across the split.

sec09-card-sec09-F35.question_text: How should you adjust your speed when a curve warning sign includes an advisory speed plaque?
sec09-card-sec09-F35.teaching_text: Entering a tight bend faster than its advisory number risks sliding across the center line or off the shoulder.

sec09-card-sec09-R11.question_text: What two steps should you take when you see a yellow roundabout warning sign?
sec09-card-sec09-R11.teaching_text: Dropping to advisory pace before the yield line lets you merge smoothly or stop cleanly for circulating cars.

sec09-card-sec09-R12.question_text: How does a winding road warning sign differ from a road turns ahead sign?
sec09-card-sec09-R12.teaching_text: Multiple S-bends demand sustained steady steering, whereas a sharp ninety-degree turn sign requires deeper braking.

sec09-card-sec09-R13.question_text: What roadway transition does a Two-Way Traffic Ahead sign announce, and where must you position your car?
sec09-card-sec09-R13.teaching_text: Forgetting your one-way street is becoming two-way leaves you cruising in the left lane straight toward oncoming traffic.

sec09-card-sec09-R14.question_text: How do the Divided Highway Begins and Divided Highway Ends warning signs differ?
sec09-card-sec09-R14.teaching_text: Keep right of the island nose when a divider starts, and stay alert for undivided opposing traffic when it ends.

sec09-card-sec09-R15.question_text: What does a yellow diamond showing red, yellow, and green circles warn is coming up?
sec09-card-sec09-R15.teaching_text: Blind curves and highway hills post signal-ahead diamonds so fast traffic never rounds a bend into a surprise red light.

sec09-card-sec09-R16.question_text: What three categories of road crossers do general yellow crossing signs warn you to watch for?
sec09-card-sec09-R16.teaching_text: Deer trails, hikers, farm tractors, or fire trucks cross unexpectedly wherever silhouette diamonds stand.

sec09-card-sec09-F36.question_text: What road condition does a Slippery Road sign warn of, and where is it commonly placed?
sec09-card-sec09-F36.teaching_text: Exposed bridge decks and overpasses lose heat from underneath, turning rain or frost slick long before solid ground.

sec09-card-sec09-R17.question_text: What does a Steep Hill sign warn is ahead, and what vehicle check should you make before descending?
sec09-card-sec09-R17.teaching_text: Testing brake response at the crest lets you downshift or pull off safely before gravity builds runaway downhill speed.

sec09-card-sec09-F37.question_text: When a Lane Ends sign shows the right lane tapering away, which drivers must yield and merge?
sec09-card-sec09-F37.teaching_text: Drivers in the continuing through lane hold right-of-way, so the disappearing lane must match speed and merge cleanly.

sec09-card-sec09-R18.question_text: How do your duties differ at a Lane Ends sign, a Merging Traffic sign, and an Added Lane sign?
sec09-card-sec09-R18.teaching_text: Added lanes give incoming ramps their own fresh lane, eliminating unnecessary brake checks or last-second lane swaps.
sec09-card-sec09-R18.must_match_memory_hook: Ending yields, merge shares, added free

visual_sync.text_span: Ending yields, merge shares, added free

sec09-card-sec09-F38.question_text: What must you do at a Low Clearance sign if your vehicle or rooftop load exceeds the posted height?
sec09-card-sec09-F38.teaching_text: Forcing a tall box truck or roof rack under a low overpass wedges the vehicle and shears the roof.

sec09-card-sec09-R19.question_text: What change in roadway width does a Narrow Bridge warning sign announce?
sec09-card-sec09-R19.teaching_text: Shoulders often vanish on older spans, requiring extra care when meeting wide trucks or trailers.

sec09-card-sec09-F39.question_text: What hazards do orange signs with black lettering warn of, and how should you respond?
sec09-card-sec09-F39.teaching_text: Restricted lanes, detours, and fresh gravel inside construction zones leave tiny margins at full highway speed.

sec09-card-sec09-F40.question_text: What job do orange drums, cones, arrows, and striped barriers do, and whom must you always obey?
sec09-card-sec09-F40.teaching_text: Cones wall off open trenches and workers, while human flaggers override normal flow to guide single-lane traffic safely.

sec09-card-sec09-R20.question_text: What does an orange warning sign showing a person holding a flag tell you?
sec09-card-sec09-R20.teaching_text: Spotting the flagger symbol warns that stopped traffic or a paddle command can appear just around the next cone line.

sec09-card-sec09-R21.question_text: How should you adjust speed and lane placement when an orange Road Work sign shows workers?
sec09-card-sec09-R21.teaching_text: Edging toward the far side of your lane adds precious buffer space for crews working next to cones.

sec09-card-sec09-R22.question_text: What speed-limit change is commonly posted through active construction and maintenance zones?
sec09-card-sec09-R22.teaching_text: Narrow temporary lanes and concrete barriers require lower posted speeds to keep stopping distances manageable.

sec09-card-sec09-F41.question_text: What fine hits drivers who exceed a posted work-zone speed limit while workers are present?
sec09-card-sec09-F41.teaching_text: Minnesota enforces a steep three-hundred-dollar penalty whenever speeding puts live road crews at risk.

sec09-card-sec09-R23.question_text: Which destinations do brown roadside guide signs point drivers toward?
sec09-card-sec09-R23.teaching_text: Brown backgrounds separate scenic parks, trails, and historic landmarks from standard green exit signs.

sec09-card-sec09-R24.question_text: Which six kinds of roadside stops do blue motorist-service signs help you find?
sec09-card-sec09-R24.teaching_text: Blue interchange panels let travelers plan fuel, food, rest areas, or emergency hospital exits well before the ramp.

sec09-card-sec09-R25.question_text: What five pieces of directional info appear on green highway and street signs?
sec09-card-sec09-R25.teaching_text: Green overhead and roadside signs guide lane choices early for exits, city distances, street names, and bike routes.

sec09-card-sec09-R26.question_text: Which four levels of roadways get their own distinct route-marker sign shapes in Minnesota?
sec09-card-sec09-R26.teaching_text: Recognizing shield styles confirms whether you are on an interstate freeway, US highway, state route, or county road.

sec09-card-sec09-R27.question_text: What two main goals do traffic-control signals serve at busy intersections?
sec09-card-sec09-R27.teaching_text: Timed signal phases take guesswork out of heavy multi-lane crossings so traffic moves predictably without collisions.

sec09-card-sec09-F42.question_text: How must you treat an intersection when its traffic signal is dark or completely out of order?
sec09-card-sec09-F42.teaching_text: Blowing through a dead traffic light at full speed causes devastating T-bone crashes during power outages.

sec09-card-sec09-F43.question_text: Even on a green light, what must be true on the far side before you enter a signalized intersection?
sec09-card-sec09-F43.teaching_text: Stopping mid-box when your light turns red traps cross traffic, blocks crosswalks, and gridlocks emergency rigs.

sec09-card-sec09-F44.question_text: In which three situations does Minnesota's intersection gridlock rule not apply?
sec09-card-sec09-F44.teaching_text: Obeying a traffic officer, clearing space for a siren, or completing a safe exit turn overrides the box restriction.

sec07-card-sec07-F01.question_text: Where exact spot must your car halt when you approach a stop sign?
sec07-card-sec07-F01.teaching_text: Rolling past the painted bar or pedestrian path puts your bumper directly into foot traffic and counts as running the sign.

sec07-card-sec07-F02.question_text: What must you do after halting at a stop sign, especially if parked cars or bushes block your view?
sec07-card-sec07-F02.teaching_text: Stopping once does not grant automatic clearance when blind corners hide cross traffic, cyclists, or walkers.

sec07-card-sec07-F03.question_text: Where must you come to a complete halt when pulling onto a street from an alley, driveway, or parking ramp?
sec07-card-sec07-F03.teaching_text: Drivers staring down the street for traffic gaps often roll straight across the sidewalk into unseen joggers or strollers.

sec07-card-sec07-F04.question_text: When may you pull forward after stopping at a steady red traffic light?
sec07-card-sec07-F04.teaching_text: Even a fresh green bulb is unsafe if straggling turners or crossing walkers are still clearing the box.

sec07-card-sec07-R02.question_text: What is the key difference between a steady red signal and a flashing red signal?
sec07-card-sec07-R02.teaching_text: Waiting forever for a blinking red bulb to turn green backs up traffic because it functions like an ordinary stop sign.

sec07-card-sec07-F06.question_text: Which everyday intersection sign works the exact same way as a flashing red traffic light?
sec07-card-sec07-F06.teaching_text: Treating a blinking red like a caution light triggers broadside collisions with cross traffic that has the right-of-way.

sec07-card-sec07-F05.question_text: How long must you stay stopped when a pedestrian or cyclist is crossing in a marked or unmarked crosswalk?
sec07-card-sec07-F05.teaching_text: Creeping around someone's heels while they are still in your travel path is illegal and leaves zero margin if they stumble.

sec07-card-sec07-F07.question_text: Name four other roadside situations besides stop signs and intersection lights that demand a full stop?
sec07-card-sec07-F07.teaching_text: Rolling past a red ramp meter, rail stop sign, flagger paddle, or raised boat bridge carries the same crash and ticket risk.

sec07-card-sec07-F08.question_text: In a speed zone of 35 mph or slower, how far before stopping does a school bus start flashing yellow lights?
sec07-card-sec07-F08.teaching_text: Spotting overhead amber strobes gives you a brief city-block buffer to ease off the gas instead of slamming brakes.

sec07-card-sec07-F09.question_text: When the speed limit is over 35 mph, how far in advance does a school bus activate its flashing yellow lights?
sec07-card-sec07-F09.teaching_text: Higher highway speeds eat up pavement fast, so bus drivers triple the amber warning distance to prevent rear-end crashes.

sec07-card-sec07-R01.question_text: How do the two minimum yellow-light warning distances on a stopping school bus compare across speed zones?
sec07-card-sec07-R01.teaching_text: Mixing up the thirty-five-mile-per-hour cutoff is a classic permit trap on Minnesota school bus distance questions.
sec07-card-sec07-R01.must_match_memory_hook: One hundred slow, three hundred fast

visual_sync.text_span: One hundred slow, three hundred fast

sec07-card-sec07-F10.question_text: Is it ever legal to pass on the right side of a school bus flashing yellow or red lights?
sec07-card-sec07-F10.teaching_text: Students step directly off the right-side curb door, making a shoulder or curb-lane pass around a flashing bus deadly.

sec07-card-sec07-F11.question_text: How far away must you stop when a school bus halts with its red lights flashing?
sec07-card-sec07-F11.teaching_text: Parking twenty feet back creates a visible safety zone around the front bumper and rear corners where small kids cross.

sec07-card-sec07-F12.question_text: Whether approaching from ahead or behind, when may you move again after stopping for a school bus?
sec07-card-sec07-F12.teaching_text: Pulling forward the instant the last student steps onto the grass risks hitting a late runner dashing back toward the bus.

sec07-card-sec07-F13.question_text: What offense class, minimum fine, and license consequence hit a driver convicted of failing to stop for a school bus?
sec07-card-sec07-F13.teaching_text: Minnesota treats blowing past a loading bus as a serious crime that immediately strips your driving privileges and drains your wallet.

sec07-card-sec07-F14.question_text: When are oncoming drivers exempt from stopping for a school bus displaying flashing red lights?
sec07-card-sec07-F14.teaching_text: Students never cross a separated highway median to board, whereas slamming brakes on the far side of a divided road causes pileups.

sec07-card-sec07-R03.question_text: On a road with no median divider, which directions of traffic must stop for a school bus flashing red?
sec07-card-sec07-R03.teaching_text: Painted center lines on multi-lane streets do not count as a divider, so oncoming lanes must still freeze twenty feet back.

sec07-card-sec07-R04.question_text: Within how many hours of an illegal school bus pass can an officer with probable cause arrest the driver?
sec07-card-sec07-R04.teaching_text: Bus drivers radio plate numbers immediately, allowing police to track down violators at home or school hours after the pass.

sec07-card-sec07-F15.question_text: What happens to a vehicle's owner or lessee if someone uses their car to illegally pass a stopped school bus?
sec07-card-sec07-F15.teaching_text: Loaning out your car makes you legally answerable for a petty misdemeanor unless you identify who was actually behind the wheel.

sec07-card-sec07-R05.question_text: How does the charge against the actual driver compare with the charge against the vehicle's owner in a school bus violation?
sec07-card-sec07-R05.teaching_text: Written exams test the exact distinction between the criminal misdemeanor for driving past the bus and the lesser owner offense.

sec07-card-sec07-R06.question_text: What specific promise about school buses do you certify when signing a Minnesota license application?
sec07-card-sec07-R06.teaching_text: Claiming you did not know the stopping distance or penalties never works in court once your signature is on file.

sec07-card-sec07-F16.question_text: What action must you take for a student safety patrol or an adult crossing guard holding a stop sign or flag?
sec07-card-sec07-F16.teaching_text: Slow-rolling past a student flagger or crossing guard endangers kids who step off the curb trusting traffic has frozen.

sec07-card-sec07-F17.question_text: What happens legally if you drive through a line of children crossing the road even when no patrol is present?
sec07-card-sec07-F17.teaching_text: Children crossing as a group always command a full stop, and repeating the offense inside twelve months escalates the crime.

sec07-card-sec07-F18.question_text: When a school bus flagger holds traffic so buses can exit school grounds, when may you drive forward?
sec07-card-sec07-F18.teaching_text: Sneaking between departing buses creates blind-spot crushes, so only the flagger or a police officer can wave you through.

sec07-card-sec07-R07.question_text: What two everyday principles back right-of-way laws, and what is breaking them a top cause of?
sec07-card-sec07-R07.teaching_text: Insisting on taking a gap instead of yielding turns routine intersections into Minnesota's leading collision zones.

sec07-card-sec07-F19.question_text: When two vehicles reach an uncontrolled intersection, all-way stop, or flashing red at the same time, who yields?
sec07-card-sec07-F19.teaching_text: Hesitating or racing through a tie causes T-bone wrecks, whereas giving way to the car on your right breaks every deadlock.

sec07-card-sec07-F20.question_text: Which oncoming traffic must you yield to whenever you make a left turn?
sec07-card-sec07-F20.teaching_text: Misjudging an approaching vehicle's speed and cutting across its bow is one of the deadliest intersection mistakes.

sec07-card-sec07-F21.question_text: Even when a green left-turn arrow lights up, whom must you still yield to before completing your turn?
sec07-card-sec07-F21.teaching_text: A protected green arrow gives priority over new traffic, never permission to hit walkers or late cars clearing the box.

sec07-card-sec07-F22.question_text: Who must yield at an uncontrolled T-intersection where one street dead-ends into a through road?
sec07-card-sec07-F22.teaching_text: Because your road ends and forces a turn, drivers cruising straight along the top of the T keep continuous right-of-way.

sec07-card-sec07-F23.question_text: When driving in the right lane, which buses signaling to pull back into traffic must you yield to?
sec07-card-sec07-F23.teaching_text: Crowding a transit, metro mobility, or left-signaling school bus traps heavy coaches on shoulders and triggers sideswipes.

sec07-card-sec07-F24.question_text: How do vehicles in a funeral procession mark themselves, and what must other drivers do?
sec07-card-sec07-F24.teaching_text: Cutting into a lit motorcade splits grieving families apart and surprises drivers following closely in formation.

sec07-card-sec07-R08.question_text: What two yielding duties apply when leaving a private driveway and whenever pedestrians cross at intersections?
sec07-card-sec07-R08.teaching_text: Whether crosswalk lines are painted or unpainted, walkers crossing at corners and across driveways always hold priority.

sec07-card-sec07-F25.question_text: How must you clear the way for an approaching emergency vehicle on two-way roads, one-way streets, and inside intersections?
sec07-card-sec07-F25.teaching_text: Freezing mid-intersection blocks the rig's turn radius, so clear the box first and stay parked until every siren passes.

sec07-card-sec07-F26.question_text: When are you allowed to keep driving instead of stopping for an approaching emergency vehicle?
sec07-card-sec07-F26.teaching_text: When a wall, fence, or raised median separates the lanes, panic-stopping on your side only causes pointless rear-end crashes.

sec07-card-sec07-R09.question_text: How long after failing to yield to an emergency vehicle can an officer with probable cause arrest you?
sec07-card-sec07-R09.teaching_text: Dashcams on patrol cars and fire rigs capture plates cleanly, giving police a four-hour window to make an arrest.

sec07-card-sec07-F27.question_text: On a road with at least two lanes your way, what must you do for a stopped flashing emergency vehicle or tow truck?
sec07-card-sec07-F27.teaching_text: Highway speeds create mirror-clipping wind blasts inches from responders and tow operators working beside live traffic.

sec07-card-sec07-R10.question_text: Beyond police, fire, ambulances, and tow trucks, which other stopped vehicles does Minnesota's Move Over rule protect?
sec07-card-sec07-R10.teaching_text: Drivers changing a flat tire or operating plows, mail vans, utility rigs, and garbage trucks face the same roadside danger.

sec07-card-sec07-F28.question_text: What must you do for a stopped flashing roadside vehicle if heavy traffic or a single lane keeps you from moving over?
sec07-card-sec07-F28.teaching_text: Never swerve blindly into another car to change lanes; scrubbing speed gives roadside workers breathing room instead.

sec07-card-sec07-F29.question_text: How far back must ordinary drivers stay behind a firefighting vehicle on an emergency run?
sec07-card-sec07-F29.teaching_text: Fire engines carry massive weight and may halt abruptly at hydrants or scene entrances, crushing tailgaters.

sec07-card-sec07-R11.question_text: When, if ever, may you drive across an unprotected fire hose stretched over the street?
sec07-card-sec07-R11.teaching_text: Crushing a pressurized supply line cuts water pressure instantly to firefighters battling flames inside a structure.

sec07-card-sec07-R12.question_text: How should you set and adjust your following distance behind the vehicle ahead?
sec07-card-sec07-R12.teaching_text: Tailgating steals the reaction window you need to brake smoothly or steer clear when traffic ahead slams on the brakes.

sec07-card-sec07-F30.question_text: How does Minnesota law distinguish careless driving from reckless driving, and where does racing fit?
sec07-card-sec07-F30.teaching_text: Street racing counts as reckless driving even under the posted speed limit because you consciously gamble with bystanders' lives.

sec07-card-sec07-R13.question_text: How are both careless driving and reckless driving charges classified when tried in court?
sec07-card-sec07-R13.teaching_text: Neither charge is a minor payable parking ticket; both put a criminal misdemeanor trial on your driving record.

sec07-card-sec07-F31.question_text: Where and how should you pull over when patrol lights flash behind your car?
sec07-card-sec07-F31.teaching_text: Stopping in a live lane, on a curve, or across a narrow bridge puts both you and the approaching officer in danger.

sec07-card-sec07-R14.question_text: Under what condition may you pull onto the left shoulder instead of the right during a multi-lane police stop?
sec07-card-sec07-R14.teaching_text: Diving across four fast lanes when a wide, full-lane left shoulder sits right beside you creates unnecessary crash hazards.

sec07-card-sec07-F32.question_text: Which four actions keep a nighttime traffic stop calm and safe once you park on the shoulder?
sec07-card-sec07-F32.teaching_text: Lighting the cabin and resting both hands on the wheel reassures the approaching officer in dark roadside conditions.

sec07-card-sec07-R15.question_text: What should you do during a stop if your license or insurance card is tucked out of reach, or you want to step out?
sec07-card-sec07-R15.teaching_text: Sudden lunging into a glovebox or popping your door open looks like a threat unless you speak up and get permission first.

sec07-card-sec07-F33.question_text: What exact steps should you follow during a traffic stop if there is a firearm inside your vehicle?
sec07-card-sec07-F33.teaching_text: Calmly stating the firearm's location while keeping both hands visible on the rim prevents dangerous misunderstandings.

sec07-card-sec07-R16.question_text: Where should you challenge a ticket you disagree with, and when should you ask clarifying questions?
sec07-card-sec07-R16.teaching_text: Roadside arguments never erase a ticket and only escalate tension, whereas judges weigh your side in a courtroom.

sec07-card-sec07-R17.question_text: What can happen if you refuse an officer's lawful order, and how must you act if placed under arrest?
sec07-card-sec07-R17.teaching_text: Ignoring a lawful traffic or safety command turns a routine stop into an arrest, and resisting adds criminal charges.

sec07-card-sec07-R18.question_text: What is the main safety goal behind traffic enforcement warnings and citations?
sec07-card-sec07-R18.teaching_text: Warnings and tickets exist to curb risky habits before they cause serious highway injuries or fatalities.

sec07-card-sec07-R19.question_text: What five steps will a law enforcement officer normally take when approaching your window during a stop?
sec07-card-sec07-R19.teaching_text: Knowing the standard flow takes the stress out of handing over your license and insurance while they check validity.

sec07-card-sec07-R20.question_text: Which types of driver credentials or identification are accepted during a Minnesota traffic stop?
sec07-card-sec07-R20.teaching_text: Valid out-of-state, temporary, learner, military, and consulate or international licenses all satisfy roadside ID checks.

sec07-card-sec07-F34.question_text: Does taking or signing a traffic citation mean you are admitting guilt to the violation?
sec07-card-sec07-F34.teaching_text: Refusing a ticket solves nothing because accepting it merely confirms delivery and your promise to appear if required.

sec07-card-sec07-R21.question_text: Where are citations sent for a hearing, and what alternative might the court offer instead of a conviction?
sec07-card-sec07-R21.teaching_text: Completing a court-approved driver education diversion course can keep a mistake from permanently staining your record.

sec07-card-sec07-R22.question_text: How and where should you report concerns about an officer's conduct after a traffic stop?
sec07-card-sec07-R22.teaching_text: Every printed citation lists officer identification so you can file feedback calmly with their department or supervisor later.

sec07-card-sec07-F35.question_text: What crime class, maximum prison sentence, and fine apply to fleeing a police officer in a motor vehicle?
sec07-card-sec07-F35.teaching_text: Speeding away from flashing squad lights immediately upgrades a minor traffic ticket into a prison-grade felony.

sec07-card-sec07-R23.question_text: How high do prison time and fines climb when fleeing police causes substantial harm, great bodily harm, or death?
sec07-card-sec07-R23.teaching_text: Injury and fatal pursuit crashes multiply felony sentences all the way to ten years and twenty thousand dollars.

sec07-card-sec07-F36.question_text: What does the law say about passing another vehicle that has stopped at a crosswalk for a pedestrian?
sec07-card-sec07-F36.teaching_text: The stopped car's hood hides walkers stepping into your adjacent lane, making overtake passes a classic multi-lane tragedy.

sec07-card-sec07-F37.question_text: How must you drive around a blind pedestrian using a white or metallic cane or guide dog?
sec07-card-sec07-F37.teaching_text: Blind walkers rely on traffic sound cues to orient safely, so horn blasts or revving engines startle both person and dog.

sec07-card-sec07-F38.question_text: How does an unmarked crosswalk differ visually from a marked one, and where does it exist?
sec07-card-sec07-F38.teaching_text: Drivers wrongly assume no white paint means no crosswalk, even though every corner sidewalk connection carries full crosswalk rights.

sec07-card-sec07-R24.question_text: How is a pedestrian right-of-way violation penalized the first time versus a second time within one year?
sec07-card-sec07-R24.teaching_text: Failing to yield to walkers twice inside twelve months jumps from an ordinary misdemeanor to a gross misdemeanor.

sec07-card-sec07-R25.question_text: In which three settings should you scan extra hard for pedestrians, and where must your car never stop?
sec07-card-sec07-R25.teaching_text: Children dart between parked bumpers in low visibility, and parking across a crosswalk forces walkers into live traffic.

sec07-card-sec07-R26.question_text: What four safety habits should pedestrians practice before and during a signalized intersection crossing?
sec07-card-sec07-R26.teaching_text: Standing back off the curb and making eye contact confirms turning drivers actually see you before you step out.

sec07-card-sec07-R27.question_text: Who yields when someone crosses away from a crosswalk, and which side must walkers use along a road without sidewalks?
sec07-card-sec07-R27.teaching_text: Walking on the left shoulder facing oncoming headlights lets you spot drifting drivers early and step clear.

sec07-card-sec07-R28.question_text: How can pedestrians stay visible in darkness, and what daytime hazard can still blind drivers to them?
sec07-card-sec07-R28.teaching_text: Dark hoodies vanish outside low-beam range at night, while low sun glare can wash out a windshield in broad daylight.

sec07-card-sec07-F39.question_text: How does Minnesota traffic law classify bicycles riding on public roadways?
sec07-card-sec07-F39.teaching_text: Treating cyclists like second-class obstacles ignores their full legal status, rights, and matching traffic duties.

sec07-card-sec07-F40.question_text: In which three limited situations may a motor vehicle enter a bicycle lane, and who goes first?
sec07-card-sec07-F40.teaching_text: Cruising down a bike lane is illegal, and merging across one without checking mirrors causes classic right-hook crashes.

sec07-card-sec07-R29.question_text: What exact sequence must you follow before turning right across a marked bicycle lane?
sec07-card-sec07-R29.teaching_text: Merging into the dashed bike lane ahead of the corner blocks cyclists from sneaking into your right-side blind spot.

sec07-card-sec07-F41.question_text: What is the minimum side-to-side clearance required when overtaking a bicyclist in Minnesota?
sec07-card-sec07-F41.teaching_text: Three feet gives a cyclist essential room to dodge a pothole or gust without clipping your passenger mirror.

sec07-card-sec07-F42.question_text: When may you cross the center line to overtake a bicyclist even inside a no-passing zone?
sec07-card-sec07-F42.teaching_text: Giving three feet safely beats squeezing inside one lane, provided oncoming traffic is clear and the rider stays right.

sec07-card-sec07-R30.question_text: How do Minnesota road rules treat electric-assist bicycles compared with gas-powered mopeds?
sec07-card-sec07-R30.teaching_text: Electric pedal-assist bikes follow standard bicycle laws, whereas gas-engine mopeds fall under separate restrictions.

sec07-card-sec07-F43.question_text: Which direction must bicyclists ride, and what rules apply to their turns and traffic signals?
sec07-card-sec07-F43.teaching_text: Riding against traffic surprises turning drivers looking the other way, so cyclists follow the exact same flow and signs.

sec07-card-sec07-F44.question_text: How may a bicyclist legally handle a stop sign when no vehicles are nearby?
sec07-card-sec07-F44.teaching_text: Slowing enough to halt if needed lets cyclists keep balance through empty intersections while still yielding to any traffic.

sec07-card-sec07-R31.question_text: Where in the lane do cyclists normally ride, and when may they move toward the center?
sec07-card-sec07-R31.teaching_text: Broken glass, open car doors, passing slower riders, or setting up left turns all justify a cyclist claiming center lane.

sec07-card-sec07-R32.question_text: Which arm positions let a bicyclist signal a right turn versus slowing or stopping?
sec07-card-sec07-R32.teaching_text: Recognizing either a raised left forearm or straight right arm keeps you from misreading a rider's turn or brake check.

sec07-card-sec07-R33.question_text: Under what two conditions may two bicyclists ride side by side on a Minnesota road?
sec07-card-sec07-R33.teaching_text: Riding two abreast is legal only when both riders fit within a single lane without holding up faster vehicles.

sec07-card-sec07-R34.question_text: What lighting and winter tire equipment are legal on a bicycle riding at night in Minnesota?
sec07-card-sec07-R34.teaching_text: Flashing white front and red rear lamps boost nighttime visibility, and studded bike tires are legal for icy grip.

sec07-card-sec07-R35.question_text: What duties apply when riding a bicycle on a sidewalk, and where is sidewalk riding banned by default?
sec07-card-sec07-R35.teaching_text: Storefront doors open onto busy business-district sidewalks, so cyclists must stay off them unless local signs allow it.

sec13-m03.narration_text: Here is your rapid recap of lent IDs, proxy test-takers, child support, and bounced fee checks. Illegal to lend; triggers suspension. Tobacco under eighteen; alcohol twenty-one. License-misuse suspensions are dialed in, so crush the quiz next.

sec13-m04.narration_text: Time to review test refusals, triple-digit speeding, three jailable strikes, and uninsured vehicle revocations. Failing or refusing triggers revocation. Stop, identify yourself, render aid. Revocation triggers hold zero traps now, so take on the quiz.

sec04-m02.narration_text: Time for a rapid run through three-fifty high-beam reach, five-hundred visibility, and dark daytime taillights. High beams reach three-fifty. Taillights and parkers stay dark. Take those crisp Minnesota lighting numbers straight into the quiz.

sec04-m03.narration_text: Here is your quick check on restricted blue lights, mail-carrier strobes, mufflers, and extra side mirrors. Snowplows, road maintenance, emergency rigs. Installed, worn, clean, good shape. Hit the quiz and crush every special-lighting and mirror trap.
